description: This is a PHP source file defining the Gdpr class within the Opencart\
Opencart"-  namespace, which provides methods for managing GDPR-related data such as adding GDPR requests, editing their status, and retrieving GDPR data by various identifiers.

classes.name: Gdpr
classes.description: Represents GDPR management functionalities, including adding requests, updating status, and fetching GDPR records.

methods.name: addGdpr
methods.description: Inserts a new GDPR request record into the database with store ID, language ID, code, email, and action.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of an existing GDPR record identified by gdpr_id.

methods.name: getGdpr
methods.description: Retrieves a GDPR record by its gdpr_id.

methods.name: getGdprByCode
methods.description: Fetches a GDPR record by its unique code.

methods.name: getGdprsByEmail
methods.description: Retrieves all GDPR records associated with a specific email.

methods.name: getExpires
methods.description: Gets GDPR records with status 2 older than a certain number of days as configured.
